title: [GMCP 203.026.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: OAuth-capable MCP client and authorization flow
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-026-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: The host completes secure authorization-code flows with PKCE, state and nonce binding, protected-resource discovery, authorization-server selection, exact redirect matching, refresh rotation, revocation, incremental scopes and per-resource credential binding. Dynamic registration is isolated as legacy policy; current client metadata mechanisms, loopback hardening, browser cancellation and concurrent-account flows are interoperable and attack-tested. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
